NOTE: 1997 Q3 net income figure includes gains from security transactions of $0.01/shr, while 1996 Q3 net income figure includes gains from security transactions of $0.02/shr.

Net income for nine months ended March 31, 1997 includes charge of $0.32/shr for fines and litigation settlements arising from U.S. Justice Department's antitrust investigation of the company's lysine and citric acid products, as well as resolution of a securities lawsuit filed by ADM shareholders.
Revenue figures for the third quarter and nine months will ended March 31 will be available next month, the company said.
